title: Grief-Stricken Jin - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Grief-Stricken Jin in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Grief-Stricken Jin phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Grief-Stricken Jin is a story encounter in Meigu Lake.

sections.title: Where to Find the Grief-Stricken Jin
sections.content: Location: Meigu Lake - the region itself rather than a point inside it.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: No drop is recorded for this encounter in the sources checked, so none is listed. That is a gap in the record rather than a statement that it drops nothing.

sections.title: How to Beat the Grief-Stricken Jin
sections.content:
What works

  • Clear the nearby threats before committing to the boss - the arena does not stay clear.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 40 of 60 in the progression order, in Meigu Lake. Before it: Yubi, the Swordfighter Puppet (No. 21). After it: One-Eyed Archer (独眼弓客). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
